i.norm: Tests that {@link DurationUtils#toMillisInt(Duration)} clamps to {@link Integer#MIN_VALUE} when the duration's milliseconds underflow the {@code int} range, instead of overflowing or throwing.

Pick a duration whose milliseconds are far below Integer.MIN_VALUE. Long.MIN_VALUE / 1000 seconds is roughly the most negative duration expressible in milliseconds; subtracting one more second pushes it safely past the negative int range.
The result must be clamped to the smallest int rather than wrapping around.
